page_blurb: A therapist for every employee, one click from Slack
page_intro: Tech teams move fast and burn out quietly. Layoff whiplash, always-on Slack culture, and the pressure of building against a runway make mental health support a retention lever, not a perk. Spill is mental health support for tech companies, delivered as on-demand counseling: a licensed therapist for every employee, booked from Slack or Teams in one click, often for the same day.
page_ticks: Book from Slack or Teams in one click | Same-day sessions, remote-native
page_challenges: Fast companies, quiet burnout. Sprint culture that never actually ends, on-call rotations that bleed into weekends, and post-layoff teams doing three jobs each with a side of survivor guilt. Remote-first setups mean struggling engineers can go unnoticed for months. The data backs the feeling
page_stats: Burnout, climbing: 46% of employed US tech professionals report being burned out, up from 31% in 2024. (Dice Tech Sentiment Report, 2026) | The founder toll: 72% of startup founders say entrepreneurship has taken a toll on their mental health, yet only 23% see a psychologist or coach. (Startup Snapshot, 2023) | Layoff whiplash: Only 34% of US tech professionals say they've been untouched by layoffs, down from 56% in 2023, and 22% have been personally laid off. (Dice Tech Sentiment Report, 2026)
page_benefits: A retention lever, not a perk. Support inside Slack and Teams: Booking lives where the team already works, so usage is high and struggling engineers get help before they churn. Keeping one senior engineer costs less than a month of their replacement's recruiter fee. | Built for pressure, not just crisis: Counseling and coaching for ambiguity, imposter feelings and sustained compliance-grade pressure: the real failure modes of very smart teams. Same-day sessions after major incidents help teams process a breach week instead of quietly updating their resumes. | Remote-native by default: Video sessions bookable across US time zones, so a distributed team gets identical access whether they're in New York, Austin, or working from anywhere.
page_features: Confidential sessions with licensed therapists for every employee, bookable from Slack, Teams or email in one click, often for the same day. No phone tree, no referral process, no copays.
page_faqs: What's the best mental health support for tech companies? Give people a therapist they can actually reach, through the tools they already use: booking from Slack or Teams in one click, same-day availability, and no phone tree or referral process. Spill was built by a startup, for startups. Traditional helpline-based workplace programs see 3 to 5% usage; on-demand counseling is built to be used. | What is on-demand counseling for tech companies? Confidential therapy your company pays for so employees don't have to. Everyone gets access to licensed therapists, bookable from Slack, Teams, or email and often available the same day, plus self-guided resources and manager training built for how tech teams actually work. | How does startup work affect employee mental health? Runway pressure, role ambiguity, layoff cycles, and always-on communication create chronic stress that high performers are especially good at hiding. Left unsupported, it surfaces as disengagement, conflict, and resignations, usually from the people you can least afford to lose. | Do remote and distributed teams get the same support? Yes. Spill is fully remote-native. Sessions are video-based and bookable across US time zones, so a distributed team gets identical access whether they're in New York, Austin, or working from anywhere. | Is Spill confidential? Will the company see who uses it? Sessions are completely confidential. Employers see aggregate, anonymized usage data only, never names, session content, or anything that could identify an individual. That confidentiality is exactly why employees trust it enough to use it. | Does Spill cover founders and leadership too? Yes. Founders and executives are covered on the same plan as everyone else, and use it. 72% of founders say building a company has taken a toll on their mental health; very few have anywhere confidential to take that. | How fast can we launch Spill? Setup takes hours, not months: connect Slack or Teams, announce it, and the team can book sessions the same week. No broker, no open enrollment window, no implementation project.
page_customers: Proudly supporting tech and startup teams
definition: A technology company: it makes its own software, platform, app or hardware, or builds software and apps for clients; not IT support, managed IT services or IT staffing, and not a business that only uses technology to sell something else.
